; ghostbuster-page.qmd
; Automatically clear ghosting on page turns, link clicks, dialog closes, toolbar toggles,
; and library (home) screen folder navigation
; Optimized with settle timers and cooldown rate-limiting to prevent double refreshes

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool pageRefreshPending: false
            property double lastFullClearTime: 0

            function triggerSafePageClear(reason) {
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastFullClearTime < 1200) {
                    return;
                }
                lastFullClearTime = now;
                ghostBuster.forceClearNow(reason);
            }

            function onPageTurn() {
                pageRefreshPending = true;
                if (!root.isLoading) {
                    pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.interval = 350;
                    pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.restart();
                } else {
                    pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.stop();
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: pageTurnGhostBusterTimer
                interval: 350
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (root.pageRefreshPending) {
                        if (!root.isLoading) {
                            root.pageRefreshPending = false;
                            triggerSafePageClear("Page change");
                        } else {
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.interval = 150;
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.restart();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root
                function onIsLoadingChanged() {
                    if (root.pageRefreshPending) {
                        if (root.isLoading) {
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.stop();
                        } else {
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.interval = 250;
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.restart();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: dialogGhostBusterTimer
                interval: 200
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    triggerSafePageClear("UI close");
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: toolbar
                function onShownChanged() {
                    dialogGhostBusterTimer.restart();
                }
                function onExpandedChanged() {
                    dialogGhostBusterTimer.restart();
                }
            }
        }

        REBUILD onCurrentPageChanged
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM \pageLabelTimer.restart();\ INSERT STREAM \ onPageTurn();\
        END REBUILD

        REPLACE handleDialogGhosting WITH {
            function handleDialogGhosting(isVisible) {
                if (isVisible) {
                    ghostBuster.viewChange(GhostBuster.DocumentViewDialogOpened);
                } else {
                    ghostBuster.viewChange(GhostBuster.DocumentViewDialogClosed);
                    dialogGhostBusterTimer.restart();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick 2.0
    IMPORT com.remarkable 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool isInitialized: false
            property double lastFolderClearTime: 0

            Component.onCompleted: {
                root.isInitialized = true;
            }

            function triggerSafeFolderClear() {
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastFolderClearTime < 1000) {
                    return;
                }
                lastFolderClearTime = now;
                EPFramebuffer.clearGhosting();
            }

            Timer {
                id: folderNavGhostTimer
                interval: 400
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (root.visible && root.isInitialized) {
                        triggerSafeFolderClear();
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root.explorer
                function onCurrentFolderIdChanged() {
                    if (root.visible && root.isInitialized) {
                        folderNavGhostTimer.restart();
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: _sidebar
                function onActiveViewChanged() {
                    if (root.visible && root.isInitialized) {
                        folderNavGhostTimer.restart();
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root
                function onVisibleChanged() {
                    if (root.visible && root.isInitialized) {
                        folderNavGhostTimer.restart();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
